title: A Fresh Take on Habit Tracking
body:
As an early adopter of the iPhone and a frequent user of the App Store, I've explored countless habit tracking apps over the years. Despite already having a lifetime habit app that I use regularly, the design of Grit immediately caught my eye. Initially, I wasn't looking for another habit app, as I was already using two simultaneously.

However, something about Grit intrigued me. After testing the app and interacting with the developer, who was both responsive and helpful, I found myself integrating Grit into my daily routine. The attention to detail, along with its impressive visuals and user-friendly interface, made it clear that it was crafted by someone who not only cares deeply about their work but also uses the app themselves.

Following my trial period, I've decided to pay for Grit without any hesitation. I'm grateful for developers who still dedicate so much effort to the quality and functionality of their apps.
